**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2021/08/20 (Fri) 09:51  
[FACT] User is creating a Vehicle Owner and User Management service for Polestar.  
[FACT] The service has four modules: the Registration number, owner, primary driver, and market modules.  
[FACT] User will focus on the Primary Driver module.  
[FACT] The Primary Driver module tracks the user identified with a Polestar ID who is the primary driver of a car.  
[FACT] A car can only have one primary driver.  
[FACT] The primary driver is captured from Polestar's Order Management System (POMS).  
[FACT] The service listens to order events from POMS.  
[FACT] A valid VIN and Polestar ID in the "Driver" field are required to save the Polestar ID as the car's primary driver.  
[FACT] A Polestar ID is valid if it exists in the Polestar ID service, which can be confirmed with an API call.  
[FACT] A VIN is valid if it exists in Volvo's factory order system, the Vehicle Internet Sale & Traceability Application (VISTA).  
[FACT] The service stores all events it receives in an "event store" for replay purposes.  
[FACT] The service allows other systems to change a car's primary driver through an API.  
[FACT] There are two versions of the API: one with M2M authentication and one with Polestar ID authentication (OAuth).  
[FACT] Using the Polestar ID Auth. version, the user can only edit a car's primary driver if they have access to the logged-in primary driver's credentials.  
[FACT] The service saves related information for primary driver changes, including the system that made the update, the timestamp of when the primary driver was registered, the user ID, the client ID of the service that made the change, and the event ID that caused the change.  
[FACT] If the update was made based on an event, the timestamp when the event was emitted is also saved.  
[FACT] If the primary driver is registered based on an event from POMS, the service stores the order ID from the event.  
[FACT] A POMS update can only overwrite an API update if the order ID is new.  
[FACT] The service maintains a history for primary drivers.  
[FACT] When a new primary driver is registered, the previous primary driver is given an end timestamp.  
[FACT] It is possible to remove a primary driver from a car without registering a new one using the APIs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Primary Driver module is a useful tool for tracking and managing the primary drivers of cars in the Polestar system.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The service provides an up-to-date and comprehensive view of primary drivers and their associated cars.
